hero.title: Al-Sarh Al-Mutakamel Company for General Trading, General Contracting and Real Estate Investments LLC
hero.lead: Integrated general contracting, trading and real estate investment for government, healthcare, industrial, commercial and residential projects in Iraq. We design, build, equip and maintain under one management, with scope, schedule and cost set out in the contract.

cta.title: Ready to start your project?
cta.text: Send us your project details and we will come back with a written, itemized quotation, usually within one working day.

header.title: Three Services. One Company.
header.lead: Our name says what we do: trading, contracting and real estate investment. With all three in one company, there are fewer intermediaries, and supply and construction are easier to coordinate.

items.text: Residential and commercial projects delivered under direct engineering supervision at every stage.

Renovation and rehabilitation of existing buildings

list: WPC panels for facades and interiors

Supply of medical equipment and furniture

header.title: From Blueprint to Handover
header.lead: Every project passes through five stages. We do not move to the next stage until the previous one is inspected and accepted, and we report progress to you at each stage.

steps.title: Study & Costing
steps.text: Site visit, soil testing where required, and a detailed bill of quantities with a written quotation. You approve the scope and price before any work starts.

steps.title: Design & Permits
steps.text: Architectural and structural drawings, and handling of the building-permit process. Drawings are reviewed with you and revised until approved.

steps.title: Foundations & Structure
steps.text: Excavation, foundations and concrete, with rebar inspected before every pour. Progress photos are shared after each pour.

steps.title: MEP & Finishes
steps.text: Electrical and plumbing before plastering, then flooring and facades. Each trade is checked against the drawings before it is closed.

steps.title: Inspection & Handover
steps.text: A final walkthrough with you, then handover under the contract terms, including any agreed warranty period. Snag items are fixed and signed off before final payment.

header.title: Why Al-Sarh Al-Mutakamel?
header.lead: Our management’s experience in construction, project management and real estate finance, applied to the Iraqi market.

items.title: Written, itemized quotations
items.text: A detailed bill of quantities before signing. Any change to price or scope goes through a written change order under the contract.

items.title: Direct materials supply
items.text: Sourcing materials through our own trading division gives us closer control over quality and delivery schedules.

items.title: Inspection before every stage
items.text: Our procedures require work to be inspected before it is covered, from foundation rebar to in-wall services.

items.title: Regular progress reports
items.text: Photos and progress updates at the frequency agreed in the contract.

items.title: One company, one responsibility
items.text: Design, supply, construction and maintenance sit under one management, so there is a single point to call when something needs to change.

items.title: Local market knowledge
items.text: We know Iraqi suppliers, authorities and site conditions, and plan schedules and budgets around them rather than around assumptions.

header.title: Our Partners & Strategic Relationships
header.lead: We work with companies specializing in logistics, international trade, technology and AI. Each is an independent company, and details of each relationship are available on request.

items.text: A delivery and logistics network in Iraq, handling orders for restaurants and online stores with live tracking for every shipment.

A business-to-business platform connecting manufacturers, logistics providers and financial services: verified suppliers, quotes and digital contracts, freight booking, tracking and customs clearance.
An Iraqi marketplace connecting factories in Turkey and China with wholesale buyers, resellers and consumers, with escrow until delivery is confirmed and delivery through the JayakHub network.
An online store for electronics and accessories, including computers, phones, smartwatches, cameras and game consoles.
An automation platform that replaces repetitive manual work with AI agents: lead response, follow-up, scheduling and intake on one connected system.
An AI assistant that answers new real estate inquiries within about a minute by text and chat, and qualifies each lead before handing it to the right agent.
A field-operations system for short-term rental owners: cleanings, inspections, damage reports and supplies, verified by photo and location before each guest arrives.
A parental-controls suite protecting children across phones, computers and the browser: web filtering, app blocking, screen-time limits and location.
A luxury menswear house founded in San Francisco in 1865, offering tailored suits, shirts and refined clothing in fabrics from leading Italian mills.
A corporate business website presenting the company’s services, profile and the ways clients can get in touch.
A real estate website listing properties for sale and rent, with search by location and type and a direct inquiry to the agent.
A technology group delivering software across many stacks: SaaS products, web and mobile applications, cloud infrastructure and custom development for companies.
